contribution.summary: Independently qualify a zero-dependency Scientific calendar NuGet candidate from all sixteen unchanged source files and fifteen source-free numerical oracles, without publishing.
contribution.value: Restore/build/pack the original Scientific project in locked offline mode, inspect exact original source/lockfile identities, real nuspec and DLL SHA-256, then run a fresh one-PackageReference binary consumer.
debtChanges: Six Math packages are independently published and qualified in NUGET_LOCAL; Scientific is only an unpublished candidate and must not reuse rehearsal bytes for immutable publication.
Original Scientific source Version 1.1.0-preview.14 and all 16 C# files, csproj and lockfile remain unchanged, with 18 SHA-256 source fingerprints and 541 completed native nodes retained.
Fifteen binary examples span exact/scalar/geometry/signal/series/financial/refusal contracts but do not certify every Scientific API, other OS/RIDs or error guarantees.
No public license, private publication, installed rollback, Discovery/Decision/AURA adoption or another repository modification is authorized.
